title: Warehouse Robot Navigation
description: An automated warehouse robot is placed at the top-left corner of a grid floor represented by dimensions m x n. The robot must navigate to the bottom-right corner to retrieve a parcel. The robot can only move either down or right at any point in time. Determine the total number of unique paths the robot can take to reach the destination.
constraints: The answer is guaranteed to be less than or equal to 2 * 10^9
input_format: Two integers m and n representing the number of rows and columns.
output_format: An integer representing the total unique paths.

examples.explanation: For a 3x7 grid, there are 28 unique paths from top-left to bottom-right.
From the top-left (0,0), there are 3 ways to reach (2,1): Right->Down->Down, Down->Right->Down, Down->Down->Right.
